Job description: Laravel Developer


About the Role:

We are looking for a skilled Laravel Developer to join our development team. You will design, build, and maintain web applications using Laravel and React.js, working closely with designers, developers, and project managers to deliver reliable, high-performing solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient and reliable web applications using Laravel.
  • Build responsive user interfaces using React.js and integrate them with server-side logic.
  • Design and maintain MySQL databases and optimize queries for performance.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party APIs to connect applications with other services and platforms.
  • Identify and fix bugs and performance bottlenecks to keep applications fast and responsive.
  • Conduct code reviews to maintain code quality and adherence to coding standards.
  • Implement security measures to protect applications from common vulnerabilities.
  • Use Git for version control, including branching, merging, and collaboration.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute ideas during project discussions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for the codebase, APIs, and processes.
  • Stay updated on Laravel, PHP, and React.js developments and best practices.

  • Strong working knowledge of MySQL, including database design and query optimization (must have).
  • Proficiency in PHP and a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience in RESTful API development and integration.
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to commute/relocate: Jhalana Doongri, Jaipur, Rajasthan

jobs.sanitizedComment:
Summary -

  • We are looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to build and operate the Azure foundation for our AI workloads and serve as the working bridge between the Cloud Infrastructure and Data teams. You will own Terraform-driven Azure infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, and hands-on platform components, including Azure AI Foundry, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and Databricks.

Responsibilities -

  • Build and maintain Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform, including reusable modules and multi-environment patterns.
  • Provision and operate Azure AI Foundry hubs and projects, including model deployments, data connections, and identity and network configuration.
  • Design and secure MCP servers that expose internal tools and data to AI agents.
  • Partner with the Data team to deploy and configure Databricks workspaces, including VNet injection, private endpoints, Entra ID integration, and Unity Catalog.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for infrastructure and AI platform deployments.
  • Enforce guardrails for AI workloads, including Key Vault secrets management, managed identities, and network isolation.
  • Monitor platform health, reliability, and cost with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Triage cross-team platform requests, document reference patterns, and remove blockers between Cloud and Data teams.\

Requirements -

  • 4 to 8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering.
  • Strong hands-on Azure experience, including networking, Entra ID, RBAC, and managed identities.
  • Advanced Terraform skills, including module design and state management.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, including access control and network integration.
  • Practical understanding of MCP and the security considerations for connecting AI agents to enterprise systems.
  • Hands-on Databricks platform experience, including workspace deployment, Unity Catalog, and cluster configuration.
  • Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Experience working within SOC 2 Type II or similar control frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Experience with RAG architectures or Azure AI Search.
  • Experience with GPU capacity and quota planning in Azure.

companyDetails.description:
About Budget India Tours – Your Local Travel Partner for Exploring India

Welcome to Budget India Tours, your trusted partner for discovering India's rich history, vibrant culture, beautiful landscapes and famous travel destinations. With over 25 years of experience in the travel industry, Budget India Tours is a unit of Jindal Tours, specialising in private, customised and chauffeur-driven holidays across India.


We believe every traveller deserves a journey that matches their interests, travel style and budget. Whether you are visiting India for the first time, planning a family holiday, exploring historic monuments or looking for a wildlife adventure, we help create personalised itineraries that let you discover India at your own pace.


Discover India Through Private and Customised Tours

Our speciality is tailor-made private tours covering India's most popular destinations and travel routes. We organise the famous Golden Triangle Tours covering Delhi, Agra and Jaipur, along with extended journeys to Rajasthan, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, Pushkar, Ranthambore and other parts of the country.


Our tour collection also includes Taj Mahal sightseeing, sunrise and same-day Agra trips, Rajasthan heritage holidays, tiger safari experiences, birdwatching tours, spiritual journeys and multi-day cultural itineraries.


From the architectural beauty of the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort to Jaipur's royal palaces, Rajasthan's desert cities and India's national parks, we help you experience destinations that suit your available time and interests.


Our Travel Services

At Budget India Tours, we provide a range of travel services to make planning your India holiday easier.


  • Private Tours: Personalised itineraries for couples, families, solo travellers and groups.
  • Car Rental with Driver: Comfortable private transportation with experienced drivers for sightseeing, airport transfers and intercity journeys.
  • Hotel Bookings: Accommodation arrangements based on your preferred comfort level, location and budget.
  • Professional Tour Guides: Local guides who explain the history, architecture, culture and traditions of India's famous attractions.
  • Day Trips and Excursions: Same-day sightseeing experiences and short trips from major destinations.
  • Customised Tour Packages: Flexible travel plans designed around your dates, interests, destinations and budget.
  • 24/7 Travel Assistance: Support with travel arrangements and assistance during your journey.


Why Choose Budget India Tours?

With more than 25 years of travel industry experience, we understand the practical needs of travellers exploring India. Our approach combines local destination knowledge, private transportation and personalised travel planning.

We focus on:

  • Over 25 years of experience in the travel industry.
  • 100% private and tailor-made travel experiences.
  • Experienced drivers and professional local guides.
  • Flexible itineraries based on your interests and budget.
  • Clear pricing with no hidden charges.
  • Assistance before and during your journey.


Explore India's Popular Destinations

Whether you want to discover the historic cities of North India, explore Rajasthan's royal heritage or experience India's wildlife, we can help you plan your route.


Our popular destinations include Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Pushkar, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, Ranthambore, Bharatpur, Varanasi and other fascinating places across India.


You can also combine destinations to create a longer holiday, such as a Golden Triangle tour with Rajasthan, a Taj Mahal visit with a tiger safari, or a cultural journey extending to Varanasi and Khajuraho.


Plan Your Private India Holiday

Not sure where to begin? Share your travel dates, number of travellers, preferred destinations and approximate budget with our team. We will help you choose suitable routes, suggest places to visit and prepare a customised itinerary.


You are welcome to share your own travel plan for review or ask us for complimentary itinerary advice before booking.

Whether you need a private car and driver, a short sightseeing trip, a Taj Mahal excursion or a complete India holiday, Budget India Tours is here to help.


Discover India your way with Budget India Tours – private journeys, local expertise and personalised travel experiences across India.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
The Mission

At TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest), we aren't just automating scripts — we're deprecating the era of manual-heavy testing. We're building the world's first AI-native platform where Agentic Intelligence autonomously plans, authors, and self-heals the entire Quality Engineering lifecycle. The name "TestMu" comes from our community conference — our users and team aren't an audience, they're the heartbeat of what we build. We believe AI augments human potential, not replaces it.

As our Performance Marketer, you'll own the Google Ads engine that puts our agentic platform in front of engineering leaders, QA heads, and CTOs defining the next decade of testing. Google Ads as your primary lever. 70+ live campaigns as your canvas. Pipeline as your scoreboard.

The Pillars of Impact

🚀 Google Ads Execution & Scale 50%

  • Own Google Ads end-to-end across 70+ live campaigns — Brand, Competitor, Generic/Non-brand, Performance Max, AI Max, Search, Display, Video.
  • Manage $25K+ in monthly spend with disciplined CPC strategy — competitor campaigns the highest, generic second, brand lowest, calibrated to funnel stage.
  • Default to Phrase and Exact match types for new keyword builds; use Broad with intent, never by default, and keep auction waste out of the system.
  • Diagnose spend volatility in real-time — know when CPM is lifting, when creative is fatigued, when the form itself is losing conversions.

⚙️ Attribution, Analytics & Reporting 30%

  • Work fluently across attribution models — first touch, last touch, time decay, multi-touch — and know which model answers which question.
  • Build and own daily, weekly, and monthly reports that connect spend to pipeline, not just clicks to leads.
  • Use UTM parameters with discipline — campaign, source, medium, term, content — so every click is traceable to the campaign that earned it.
  • Partner with GA4, Looker Studio, and Salesforce (or any CRM) to close the loop from ad spend to revenue influenced.

🧠 Landing Pages, Creative & Optimisation 20%

  • Define landing page content and iterate on CTAs, copy, and layout — Hotjar, VWO, or similar — based on heatmaps and session data, not opinion.
  • Brief and shape ad creative with intent; AI handles the first draft, you handle the judgement on what actually converts.
  • Run continuous A/B tests across copy, creative, and landing flows — document what wins and what doesn't for the team's playbook.

The Bar

Non-negotiables. Every signal must be a yes.

Google Ads — in-and-out knowledge.

Fluent across Brand, Competitor, Generic, P-Max, AI Max. Not basic Search vs Display. You've shipped campaigns, not just reported on them.

$25K+ monthly budget managed.

Firm baseline. $20K considered only when every other signal is strong. Below $20K, this isn't the seat.

Attribution and diagnostic fluency.

First touch, last touch, time decay, multi-touch — you know them, and know when to use which. UTM depth is second nature.

Extreme Ownership.

Execution-first now, full channel strategy ownership as it evolves. You don't wait for the playbook. You write it.

The Interview Loop

Three rounds. Sharp, honest, and respectful of your time.

Round I · Talent Screen

30 min with the recruiting team — Google Ads fundamentals, campaign depth, baseline criteria check.

Round II · Hiring Manager

45 min with Himanshu Gulati (Director, Demand Generation) — your campaigns, your numbers, your diagnostic thinking.

Final · Leadership Conversation

30 min with our CMO — scope fit, long-term trajectory, mutual conviction.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
A freight broker's primary role is to act as an intermediary between shippers and carriers, connecting them to facilitate the transportation of goods, including finding carriers, negotiating rates, and managing the logistics of shipments. Here's a more detailed breakdown of their roles and responsibilities:Key Responsibilities:

  • Connecting Shippers and Carriers:Freight brokers find suitable carriers for shippers and match them with available loads.
  • Negotiating Rates:They negotiate shipping rates and contracts with carriers to secure the best prices for their clients.
  • Managing Logistics:They coordinate the entire shipping process, from pickup to delivery, including scheduling, tracking, and addressing any issues that arise.
  • Handling Paperwork:They ensure all necessary paperwork, such as bills of lading and insurance certificates, is completed and accurate.
  • Ensuring Compliance:They stay up-to-date with transportation regulations and ensure all shipments comply with relevant laws and safety standards.
  • Building Relationships:They maintain strong relationships with both shippers and carriers to build a reliable network and facilitate future business.
  • Vetting Carriers:They assess the reliability and safety records of carriers to ensure the safe and efficient transportation of goods.
  • Tracking and Managing Shipments:They monitor the progress of shipments and provide updates to shippers, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Resolving Issues:They address any problems or delays that may occur during the shipping process, working with both shippers and carriers to find solutions.
  • Managing Financial Transactions:They handle payments between shippers and carriers, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing and settlements

A BIT ABOUT US:


Appknox is one of the top Mobile Application security companies recognized by Gartner and G2. A profitable B2B SaaS startup headquartered in Singapore & working from Bengaluru.


The primary goal of Appknox is to help businesses and mobile developers secure their mobile applications with a focus on delivery speed and high-quality security audits. Appknox has helped secure mobile apps at Fortune 500 companies with major brands spread across regions like India, South-East Asia, Middle-East, US, and expanding rapidly. We have secured 300+ Enterprises globally.


We are a 70+ incredibly passionate team working to make an impact and helping some of the biggest companies globally. We work in a highly collaborative, very fast-paced work environment. If you have what it takes to be part of the team, we are excited and let’s speak further.



The Opportunity:


Customer Success contributes to our efforts to enhance and transform the Appknox customer experience via a customer-centric approach (building and maintaining relationships, proactively identifying potential crises that may be detrimental to the user experience, meeting, and exceeding customer expectations). Thus, helping to differentiate Appknox.This position provides the opportunity to tame different use cases across multiple industries and interact with some of the smartest individuals from other fast-growing companies that are our customers. We see this role requiring an intersection of three key skills – Business Acumen & Problem solving, Product Perspective, and People Skills.




Responsibilities:


  • Manage a portfolio of current customers. 
  • Understand the customer’s goals, establish a trusted relationship and ensure that they are successful in achieving their business goals using Appknox. 
  • Own the customer lifecycle journey from onboarding to adoption, renewal, and growth.
  • Organize, analyze, prioritize, and share customer feedback with concerned stakeholders to ensure we always consider the voice of the customer.
  • Drive live demos and product implementation for your customers when onboarding and support existing clients on issues and tickets.
  • Prepare and collate all materials and participate with customers on QBR exercises to address existing gaps and identify new opportunities/use cases.

What An Ideal Candidate Would Look Like:


  • 2+ years of working experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Customer Onboarding roles at SaaS companies.
  • Good communication skills especially with Enterprise customers from around the globe are necessary.
  • Must have experience in upselling, cross selling and gauge customer requirements.
  • Must have good presentation skills and hold of understanding customer’s business requirements.
  • Will have worked on KPIs - customer retention, upsell revenue, cross sell revenue, QBR(Quarterly Business Reviews), referrals.

  • Must have experience of tracking product usage and instrumentation for Customer Success Management.
  • May have experience driving customer advocacy programs along with Sales and Marketing teams to build customer referral, customer case studies and testimonials.



Work Expectations:


Within 1 month

  • You should have a complete hold of the product and value customers are getting from it.
  • Interact with at least 5 enterprise customers and receive feedback that we should be focusing on.
  • Drive at least 1 QBR from existing customers.


Within 3 months

  • You need to have a clear understanding of onboarding customers. 
  • Suggest CR(Customer Requests) for the Product team to evaluate and consider in the product roadmap.
  • Complete at least 5 QBRs and also engage with 15+ customers from your book of business to ensure they get value ++.
  • Understand how to build the engagement pipeline for each of the customers you are owning and document all engagements.
  • At least 1 referral from existing customers.


Within 6 months

  • You should have discipline and document all of the ongoing discussions. 
  • Own CS for your accounts and set up a process that needs to be implemented for better customer experience.
  • We need an owner for this position who can in future build the CSM team below to drive overall customer success.


Personality traits we really admire:

  • Confident and dynamic working persona, which can bring fun to the team, and sense of humor, is an added advantage.
  • Great attitude to ask questions, learn and suggest process improvements.
  • Has attention to details and helps identify edge cases.
  • Highly motivated and coming up with fresh ideas and perspectives to help us move towards our goals faster.
  • Follows timelines and absolute commitment to deadlines.


Interview Process: 


  • Round 1 - Profile Evaluation
  • Round 2 - Task sent by Appknox, reviewed by Appknox CSM and leadership team.
  • Round 3 - Call with the CSM team to review your assignment
  • Round 4 - Call with one of the management team members to review your assignment and understand overall your experience and vision on Customer Success.
  • Round 5 - HR Discussion


Compensation:

We prefer that every employee also holds equity in the company. In this role, you will be awarded equity after 12 months, based on the impact you have created.


Please be aware that all your customers will include Enterprises and Fortune 500 companies.


Why Join Us:


  • Freedom & Responsibility: If you are a person who enjoys challenging work & pushing your boundaries, then this is the right place for you. We appreciate new ideas & ownership as well as flexibility with working hours.
  • Great Salary & Equity: We keep up with the market standards & provide pay packages considering updated standards. Also as Appknox continues to grow, you’ll have a great opportunity to earn more & grow with us. Moreover, we also provide equity options for our top performers.

jobs.headline: Backend & Platform Engineer
jobs.sanitizedComment:
Role overview

The client is building a multimodal AI platform that processes multi-hour video, audio and text to generate structured insights, narratives and highlight workflows for broadcasters and media organisations.

 

We are seeking a Backend / Platform Engineer to design and build high-throughput media pipelines, robust APIs, and model-serving infrastructure that connect our AI engine (video perception + multimodal reasoning) to real products and customer environments.

 

This is not a CRUD‑only backend role.

 

You will work on:

  • long‑running jobs
  • distributed processing
  • GPU inference orchestration
  • storage for embeddings and metadata
  • integration with AI models
  • reliability and observability at scale

 

Key responsibilities

Media ingestion & processing pipelines

  • Design and implement ingestion pipelines for multi‑hour video and audio content.
  • Build microservices for frame extraction, audio processing, transcription integration and metadata generation.
  • Handle long‑running, asynchronous jobs using queues, workers and robust retry strategies.
  • Integrate with FFmpeg or similar tools for transcoding, segmenting and preparing media for AI models.

API & platform architecture

  • Design and implement REST/gRPC APIs that expose AI model outputs (perception, multimodal alignment, narratives) to frontend and external systems.
  • Define clear contracts for internal services and external integrations.
  • Implement authentication, authorisation and rate‑limiting for platform endpoints.
  • Ensure backward‑compatible API evolution as the product matures.

Model‑serving & AI integration

  • Integrate with AI inference services (video models, multimodal models, LLM/VLM) running on GPUs or specialised infrastructure.
  • Design request/response flows that handle large payloads, streaming outputs and structured results.
  • Optimise throughput and latency for inference pipelines, including batching, caching and concurrency control.
  • Collaborate closely with AI engineers to productionise models and debug end‑to‑end behaviour.

Storage, data models & performance

  • Design data models to store embeddings, timelines, metadata, scene/shot boundaries, and narrative units.
  • Work with appropriate storage technologies (SQL/NoSQL, object storage, search indices) based on access patterns.
  • Implement indexing and query strategies for fast retrieval of segments, highlights and multimodal insights.
  • Optimise performance for large datasets and high‑volume workloads.

Reliability, observability & operations

  • Implement logging, metrics and tracing across services for debugging and monitoring.
  • Set up health checks, circuit breakers and graceful degradation for critical services.
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure safe, repeatable deployments.
  • Collaborate on Kubernetes‑based deployments (or equivalent orchestration) for scaling services.

 

Requirements (must‑have)

Experience:

  • 4–8 years in backend or platform engineering.
  • At least 3 years working on distributed systems, high‑throughput services or complex pipelines (not just simple CRUD apps).

Languages & frameworks:

  • Strong proficiency in Python or Node.js (one primary, both are a plus).
  • Experience with at least one modern backend framework (FastAPI, Flask, Express, NestJS, etc.).

Distributed systems & pipelines:

  • Hands‑on experience with queues and workers (e.g. Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, etc.).
  • Experience building asynchronous, long‑running job pipelines.
  • Understanding of idempotency, retries, backoff, and failure handling.

APIs & integration:

  • Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs (gRPC is a plus).
  • Experience integrating with external services and handling network‑level failures.

Cloud & infrastructure:

  • Experience deploying services on AWS, GCP or Azure (EC2/Compute Engine, S3/GCS, IAM, networking basics).
  • Experience with Docker; exposure to Kubernetes is a strong plus.

Data & storage:

  • Experience with SQL and at least one NoSQL store.
  • Ability to design schemas and data models for performance and maintainability.

Engineering quality:

  • Strong debugging skills across services and environments.
  • Experience with unit/integration tests for backend systems.
  • Clear, structured communication in English.

 

Nice‑to‑have

  • Experience with media/video processing (FFmpeg, transcoding, segmenting).
  • Experience with AI/ML model integration (serving models, handling inference requests).
  • Experience with search/retrieval systems (e.g. Elasticsearch, vector databases).
  • Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Experience working with remote teams across time zones.

 

What we are explicitly NOT looking for

To reduce noise and mismatches, we are not looking for:

  • Pure CRUD‑only backend developers with no pipeline or distributed systems experience.
  • Engineers who have only worked on small, single‑service apps without scale or complexity.
  • Candidates who cannot explain trade‑offs in architecture, data modelling and reliability.
  • Candidates who are uncomfortable with ownership of subsystems end‑to‑end.

 

Why join us

  • Work on real, complex problems at the intersection of media, AI and distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with senior AI engineers working on perception, multimodal fusion and narrative reasoning.
  • Build the core platform that turns AI models into a usable product for broadcasters and media organisations.
  • Operate with high ownership, clear expectations and direct access to the CTO.

About Bozzo Cabs

Bozzo Cabs is a mobility startup building a transparent ride-hailing platform designed to serve both drivers and customers.


We are preparing for our Hyderabad market rollout, starting with Bike and Auto services, with a long-term vision to expand across India.


We are looking for a highly responsible, execution-oriented City Operations Head who can take complete ownership of Hyderabad's ground operations, build the operational team, execute field activities from real-world app testing and driver onboarding to pilot execution and city launch.


Role Overview

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a desk-only management position.

The selected candidate will be responsible for building and executing Bozzo's entire Hyderabad ground operations from the initial testing stage through pilot launch and city-level expansion.


You will be expected to independently plan, execute, monitor and improve all operational activities on the ground.


You must be comfortable visiting driver locations, interacting directly with drivers and customers, managing field teams, solving operational problems and coordinating with the product and technical teams.

 1. End-to-End Field Operations- Take complete ownership of Bozzo's Hyderabad field operations.- Plan and execute daily, weekly and monthly operational activities.- Identify suitable driver acquisition locations, transport hubs, auto stands and high-demand areas.- Build operational processes from scratch.- Personally supervise field activities and ensure execution.- Identify operational challenges and resolve them independently.

 3. Driver Acquisition & Onboarding- Develop and execute a driver acquisition strategy for Hyderabad.- Recruit genuine bike and auto drivers through field activities, referrals and local networks.- Personally interact with drivers and explain Bozzo's business model.- Build and manage a driver onboarding team.- Ensure proper registration, document collection, verification and activation.- Develop strategies to convert registered drivers into active drivers.- Build strong relationships with drivers and address their concerns.- Monitor driver activation, retention, online availability and completed rides.


 4. Driver Engagement & Retention- Understand driver expectations, challenges and earning concerns.- Explain subscription and platform-fee models transparently.- Design practical driver engagement and retention initiatives.- Monitor driver activity and identify reasons for inactivity.- Build driver referral and local community networks.- Handle escalations, complaints and operational disputes.


 5. Customer Acquisition & Ground Operations- Develop offline customer acquisition strategies.- Identify high-potential customer segments, including office commuters, students and daily travellers.- Plan customer onboarding campaigns and local promotions.- Coordinate customer testing and collect feedback.- Monitor booking experience, cancellations, pickup issues and customer complaints.- Improve customer experience and repeat usage.


 6. Team Building & Management- Recruit and manage field executives and onboarding personnel.- Assign daily targets, territories and responsibilities.- Train team members on the Bozzo applications and operational procedures.- Conduct daily reviews and weekly performance assessments.- Monitor individual productivity and field execution.- Build a disciplined and accountable ground operations team.


 7. City Launch & Expansion- Prepare a practical Hyderabad pilot-launch plan.- Identify suitable launch zones and operational coverage areas.- Develop driver supply and customer demand strategies.- Ensure sufficient active driver availability in targeted locations.- Plan operational incentives within approved budgets.- Establish launch processes, escalation systems and support coordination.- Monitor city performance and recommend expansion based on actual results.

Reporting, Budget & Performance Management- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.- Manage field operations within approved budgets.- Track driver acquisition costs and activation rates.- Monitor completed rides, cancellations, driver retention and customer acquisition.- Identify operational inefficiencies and propose improvements.- Report progress, challenges and key decisions to the Founder & CEO.


Required Experience & Skills

- 3–7 years of relevant experience in mobility, ride-hailing, fleet operations, logistics or hyperlocal operations.

- Previous experience with companies such as Uber, Ola, Rapido, Namma Yatri or similar mobility platforms is strongly preferred.

- Experience in city operations, driver acquisition, fleet onboarding or ground operations.- Proven ability to build and manage field teams.

- Strong understanding of driver onboarding and ride-hailing operations.

- Experience handling operational escalations and customer/driver issues.

- Ability to manage field execution independently.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
Job Title - Customer Acquisition and Experience Lead

Experience: 2–5 Years (relevant experience) 

Location: Bengaluru, India (On-Site)

Employment Type: Full-Time (6-days Work Week)

Compensation: ₹5–8 LPA (CTC)


About Stance Health

Stance Health is an evidence-backed physiotherapy and performance healthcare company focused on injury prevention, pain management, movement optimisation, rehabilitation and performance enhancement. Through technology-backed assessments, evidence-based treatment protocols and long-term strength programmes, we help individuals recover better, move better and perform at their highest potential.

We operate five centres across Bengaluru — HSR, Whitefield, Indiranagar, JP Nagar and Koramangala — delivering 5,000+ sessions every month. As we expand across Bengaluru, we are building the systems, processes and customer experience capabilities needed to scale Stance into a leading high-performance healthcare brand.


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Customer Acquisition & Experience Lead to work closely with the founding team and own the customer journey from the first enquiry through appointment booking, centre visits, follow-ups and continued engagement. The role combines centralised calling-team management and lead conversion with customer experience, centre operations and process improvement.

You will lead the day-to-day performance of the centralised calling function, strengthen lead allocation and follow-up discipline, improve conversion, and ensure customers receive a consistent, professional experience across Stance centres. You will use CRM and calling data, customer feedback and on-ground observations to identify root causes, implement solutions and track measurable outcomes. This role requires direct ownership and execution — not just reporting, complaint handling or coordination.



Key Responsibilities

1.Customer Acquisition and Centralised Calling Ops

  • Own day-to-day centralised calling operations across inbound enquiries, outbound lead calling, appointment bookings, customer follow-ups and service-related requests.
  • Manage calling-team performance, including lead allocation, agent productivity, daily and weekly targets, workload distribution, shift/roster coordination and adherence to defined processes.
  • Improve lead conversion through timely first contact, lead prioritisation, structured follow-up schedules, clear call outcomes and regular funnel reviews.
  • Track key acquisition metrics, including first response time, contact rate, missed-call rate, follow-up adherence, appointment booking rate, lead-to-appointment conversion and no-show recovery.
  • Build reliable recovery processes for missed calls, uncontacted leads, pending follow-ups, appointment cancellations, no-shows and lost or inactive leads.
  • Use a CRM to assign and track every enquiry, follow-up, lead status, funnel stage and conversion outcome. Use cloud telephony, where available, to monitor call activity, missed calls and call recordings.
  • Review call quality and customer conversations; coach team members on communication, objection handling, follow-up discipline and conversion effectiveness.
  • Work with marketing and centre teams to improve lead handovers, lead quality feedback, appointment attendance and the transition from enquiry to centre visit.


2. Customer Experience & Journey Management

  • Own and evaluate the end-to-end customer journey, from the initial enquiry and onboarding through appointment booking, centre visits, service delivery, follow-ups and continued engagement.
  • Identify friction points, service gaps and recurring complaints that affect trust, conversion, satisfaction or retention; drive corrective action with clear ownership and timelines.
  • Improve response times, appointment coordination, customer communication, follow-up quality and issue resolution across customer touchpoints.
  • Track Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) through suitable feedback mechanisms, monitor complaints and resolution time, and address recurring causes rather than repeatedly escalating the same issues.
  • Strengthen customer engagement, referral, reactivation and win-back initiatives in collaboration with relevant teams.


3.Centre Operations & Process excellence

  • Visit Stance centres regularly to observe how customer-facing processes are executed and identify gaps between defined SOPs and on-ground practice.
  • Monitor adherence to standards across front-desk processes, customer communication, appointment coordination, customer handovers and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Work with centre, clinical, customer support and operations teams to resolve issues affecting service quality and customer experience.
  • Track recurring operational issues and implement practical corrective measures; support the development and improvement of scalable processes as new centres are added.


4.Retention, Engagement & Business Operations

  • Analyse missed appointments, customer drop-offs, repeat visits, retention patterns and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with relevant teams on follow-up mechanisms, referral programmes, customer engagement and reactivation initiatives.
  • Evaluate initiatives using customer and business metrics, and make improvements based on observed outcomes.
  • Contribute to sustainable revenue growth by improving lead conversion, appointment attendance, customer experience and retention.


5.Data, Team Performance & Cross Functional Execution

  • Review CRM reports, calling dashboards, customer feedback and operational data to identify bottlenecks, root causes and performance gaps.
  • Establish a practical daily/weekly review rhythm for calling performance, funnel movement, follow-up adherence, customer issues and agreed corrective actions.
  • Conduct regular performance and call-quality reviews, provide coaching and follow through on team improvement actions.
  • Prepare concise updates for the founding team covering key metrics, issues, actions taken, owners and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead customer-facing initiatives and process rollouts across calling, marketing, centre and clinical teams; take problems from identification through implementation and follow-up.


What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in inside sales, telesales, contact-centre/call-centre operations, customer acquisition, customer experience or service operations.
  • Hands-on experience in supervising or leading an inside-sales or tele-calling team, including performance monitoring, coaching, productivity and team target achievement.
  • Demonstrated ownership of lead-conversion, sales or customer-acquisition targets, with measurable outcomes.
  • Practical experience managing inbound/outbound calling, lead pipelines, lead allocation, follow-up schedules, call dispositions and escalation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience using a CRM to track leads, follow-ups, funnel stages and conversion outcomes; familiarity with cloud telephony is preferred.
  • Understanding of acquisition and calling metrics such as first response time, contact rate, missed-call recovery, follow-up adherence, appointment conversion and agent productivity.
  • Ability to use customer feedback, CRM reports and operational data to identify problems and implement measurable improvements.
  • Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for operational tracking and reporting.
  • Comfort with regular on-ground work and travel across Bengaluru centres, managing multiple priorities and working independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Healthcare or physiotherapy experience is helpful but not mandatory.


Relevant Metrics & Systems Experience

  • Acquisition Metrics: Hands-on experience tracking first response time, contact rate, missed-call rate, follow-up adherence, appointment booking rate, lead-to-appointment conversion, and no-show recovery.
  • Customer Experience Metrics: Familiarity with tracking customer satisfaction (CSAT), complaint volume, resolution time, customer feedback, and recurring service issues.
  • Calling Team Performance: Experience monitoring agent productivity, reviewing call quality, tracking target achievement, and coaching team members to improve performance.
  • CRM & Calling Systems: Hands-on experience using CRM systems to manage lead ownership, follow-up history, funnel stages, and conversion reporting. Familiarity with cloud telephony tools for tracking call activity, missed calls, and recordings is an added advantage.


Who Will Succeed in this Role?

  • Takes ownership of both team performance and the wider customer experience, rather than treating calling and service quality as separate problems.
  • Demonstrates strong people-management skills and can lead, motivate, and develop a team while maintaining high standards of customer communication and follow-up discipline. 
  • Balances conversion targets with clear, professional and trustworthy customer communication.
  • Uses data and direct observation to diagnose problems, test improvements and check whether they are sustained.
  • Is comfortable coaching frontline team members, visiting centres and working through issues with multiple teams.
  • Can move between daily execution, root-cause problem-solving, performance reviews and process improvement.


What This Role is Not

This is not a conventional customer-support or complaint-handling role, nor is it a purely analytical, reporting or coordination position. The role requires active ownership of centralised calling performance and lead conversion, alongside improving customer experience and the consistency of customer-facing processes across centres.


﻿Why Join Stance Health?

  • Work directly with the founding team on customer acquisition, experience and business priorities.
  • Help shape the centralised calling function and customer journey in a growing, multi-centre healthcare business.
  • Take ownership of initiatives that influence conversion, customer satisfaction, retention and business performance.
  • Build scalable operating practices as Stance continues to expand across Bengaluru.


If you enjoy building disciplined acquisition processes, coaching teams and improving real customer experiences through hands-on execution, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now and Take A Stance.

We are looking for a customer-focused Customer Support Executive to handle customer queries and provide timely assistance across chat, calls, and email channels. The candidate will be responsible for resolving customer concerns, providing accurate product and service information, following up on pending issues, and ensuring a smooth and satisfactory customer experience on the Aura Gold platform.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Customer Query Handling

 

  • Handle customer queries through live chat, phone calls, emails, and other communication channels.
  • Provide accurate information about Aura Gold products, digital gold transactions, purchases, sales, withdrawals, and delivery services.
  • Assist customers with account registration, KYC verification, payment processes, and app-related queries.
  • Ensure responses are clear, professional, personalised, and customer-friendly.
  • Maintain timely responses and follow up with customers to ensure their queries are addressed.

 

2. Transaction & Payment Support

 

  • Assist customers with payment-related concerns, including failed, pending, or successful transactions.
  • Handle queries related to money debited but gold not credited.
  • Support customers with Autopay registration, activation, cancellation, and transaction-related issues.
  • Follow up on pending refunds, sell transactions, and withdrawal payouts.
  • Coordinate with the relevant internal teams to resolve transaction discrepancies.

 

 

 

3. Gold Purchase, Sell & Delivery Support

 

  • Assist customers with queries related to gold purchase, selling, and withdrawal processes.
  • Provide updates on gold transaction status and applicable processes.
  • Handle customer queries regarding physical gold redemption and delivery status.
  • Follow up on delayed, missing, or incorrect gold deliveries.
  • Ensure customers receive proper guidance throughout the transaction and delivery process.

 

4. Customer Issue Resolution & Escalation

 

  • Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions within the defined timelines.
  • Handle dissatisfied customers professionally and maintain a calm, solution-oriented approach.
  • Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the Customer Support Lead.
  • Coordinate with Payments, Technology, Product, Vault, Delivery, and other relevant teams for issue resolution.
  • Immediately report suspicious transactions or suspected fraudulent activities to the concerned team.
  • Maintain proper records of customer complaints, escalations, and resolutions.

 

5. Customer Follow-ups & Engagement

 

  • Conduct regular follow-ups with customers regarding pending queries, transactions, and complaints.
  • Make outbound calls to customers wherever required for issue resolution and service updates.
  • Follow up with customers for Autopay activation and successful registration.
  • Reach out to customers for feedback and assistance based on business requirements.
  • Follow up on negative customer reviews and support efforts to improve customer satisfaction.

 

6. Customer Feedback & Quality

 

  • Maintain a high standard of customer service across all communication channels.
  • Follow approved SOPs, communication guidelines, and response templates.
  • Avoid repetitive or irrelevant copy-paste responses and ensure personalised communication.
  • Collect customer feedback and highlight recurring concerns to the Customer Support Lead.
  • Maintain professional communication and ensure customer information is handled confidentially.

 

7. Documentation & Reporting

 

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, follow-ups, and resolutions in the CRM or ticketing system.
  • Update ticket status and ensure no customer query remains unattended.
  • Prepare daily activity reports and share pending issues with the reporting manager.
  • Follow the defined shift schedule, attendance requirements, and support processes.

  • First Response Time (FRT)

  • Query Resolution TAT
  • Call & Chat Quality Audit Score
  • Autopay Follow-up and Activation

Key Skills & Competencies

 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong customer-handling and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to understand customer concerns and provide effective solutions.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Patience and empathy while handling difficult or dissatisfied customers.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
Location: Bengaluru | Experience: 10–13 years | Role: Senior Technical Architect - Javascript &AI


About us

RockED is the premier people development platform for the automotive industry, supporting the entire employee lifecycle from pre-hire and onboarding to upskilling and career transitions. With microlearning content, gamified delivery, and real-time feedback, RockED is educating the automotive workforce and solving the industry's greatest business challenges. 

The RockED Company Inc. is headquartered in Florida. Backed by top industry experts and investors, we’re a well-funded startup on an exciting growth journey. Our R&D team (Indian entity) is at the core of all product and technology innovation

We partner with 10000+ dealerships, empower 60,000+ learners, complete 15000+ certifications, and have crossed 11 million lesson completions


Check out our website: https://www.rocked.us/ 


What will you own?


  • Own the architecture of RockED’s full stack: Node.js backend services, React web apps, React Native mobile apps, data layer and cloud infrastructure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, maintainable systems with clear service boundaries, API contracts and data models.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and document key decisions and trade-offs so the whole team understands the “why.”

Zero-to-one builds and system evolution

  • Build new systems and products from scratch, from first design to production rollout.
  • Lead major system redesigns and migrations, evolving the platform without disrupting users.
  • Pay down tech debt strategically, knowing when to refactor, when to rebuild and when to leave it alone.

Hands-on engineering

  • Write production code across the stack every week. This isn’t a “slides and diagrams” architect role.
  • Build core business logic, APIs and data pipelines, and design relational database schemas for integrity, security and fast retrieval.
  • Own features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring.

Performance and user experience at scale

  • Make our apps fast, from API response times and database query optimisation to mobile app performance and front-end rendering.
  • Build with the end user in mind: smooth, reliable and responsive experiences on every device.
  • Set up observability (logging, monitoring and tracing) so problems are caught before users notice them.

AI-native architecture

  • Define how AI fits into the platform, including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents and intelligent features that make learning more personal.
  • Prototype quickly, measure honestly, and take AI from hackathon idea to production-grade feature.
  • Lead AI-assisted development in engineering: AI coding tools, automated testing and code review.

Technical influence and standards

  • Build agreement on architecture decisions through clear thinking and strong communication, not authority.
  • Explain complex trade-offs simply to engineers, product managers and leadership alike.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, and raise the technical bar across the team.
  • Work closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well-built products and shape the technical roadmap.


Who Tends to Thrive Here?


Experience

  • 10–13 years in software engineering, with significant experience at high-growth, product-based startups.
  • Proven experience building systems from zero to one and leading major architecture and design changes.
  • Prior work on B2C applications where performance and user experience mattered.

Technical depth (must-have)

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in the JavaScript ecosystem: Node.js on the backend; React and React Native on the frontend.
  • Strong command of relational databases: schema design, query optimisation, indexing and data integrity.
  • Solid system design: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design (REST/GraphQL) and caching strategies.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), code quality and secure coding practices (OWASP).
  • Experience with Sequelize, MongoDB and AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3).
  • Experience with mobile-first products and app performance tuning.

AI expertise (must-have)

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and AI APIs.
  • A forward-looking view of where AI is heading, and how to architect for it.
  • Daily use of AI tools in your own engineering workflow.

Who you are

  • Geeky and curious: you read engineering blogs for fun, try every new tool, and are always learning.
  • A builder at heart: you’d rather ship than talk about shipping.
  • An influencer, not a manager: you lead through expertise and earn trust through good decisions.
  • A clear communicator: you make complex ideas simple and trade-offs obvious.
  • Experimental and resilient: you try bold ideas, learn quickly from what doesn’t work, and see things through to completion.


Why leaders choose RockED


  • Architect at the source: shape the technical foundation of a platform used across the US automotive industry.
  • An AI-first playground: leadership backing to experiment with and ship AI features, plus regular AI hackathons. [Add hackathon highlights and AI projects.]
  • A real seat at the table: work directly with RockED's founders and US leadership. Your voice shapes company strategy, not just engineering execution.
  • A proven business to scale: 10,000+ dealerships, 60,000+ learners and 11M+ lesson completions. You'll be scaling a business with established product-market fit.
  • Global leadership exposure: lead across US and India teams, and build your profile as a leader of global product engineering.
  • A team worth leading: engineers from IIT and ISB, and alumni of Adobe, Microsoft, Walmart and more, in a culture of high ownership and fast decision-making.
  • Room to grow with the company: as RockED scales, so does the scope of this role.
  • Care for you and your family: health and insurance coverage, fully sponsored by RockED.

The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will lead a team of Quality Analysts assigned to a project and will be responsible for coordinating all testing efforts. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will create and execute test plans and test cases to ensure adherence with specified requirements. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing using a combination of manual testing and automated tools to validate end to end system performance. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst supports external clients through their testing cycles by providing detailed release notes with every delivery, triaging issues reported, and engaging clients to review system discrepancies as needed. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will provide training t


Responsibilities:

  • Review requirement documentation to ensure understanding of the scope of the project and what needs to be tested.
  • Create and maintain test plans and test cases designed to offer adequate test coverage and minimize escaped defects.
  • Create and maintain Quality Assurance matrices of test coverage, slippage ratios, and other pertinent quality metrics.
  • Follow established quality control processes, test execution methods and standards to identify, analyze, and document issues, bugs, defects, and other problems.
  • Complete full regression testing and analyze test results.
  • Manage code and data migrations across multiple testing and production environments.
  • Perform a thorough shakeout testing after builds/installs are complete.
  • Monitor defect tracking system daily and collaborate with the development team to ensure that any defects are fixed in a timely fashion.
  • Actively participate in team meetings such as stand-up meetings and sprint retrospectives and provide testing status reporting on a regular basis.
  • Provide mentorship and ongoing support to other Quality Assurance resources.
  • Develop and document training materials and job aids aimed at fostering more efficient and consistent practices across implementations.
  • Evaluate existing practices, identify, and implement process improvement initiatives.
  • Take ownership of all functional areas and features on assigned client implementations.
  • Reinforce the use of best practices on the team and motivate the team to be more productive.
  • Assist with recruitment and onboarding of new hires.
  • Lead team of 2-3 Quality Assurance resources and coordinate all testing activities on assigned projects.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Katalon, Playwright, or Selenium (Java), ensuring reliable and scalable test coverage.
  • Utilize Git branching strategies and CI/CD concepts to integrate automated test execution into build and deployment pipelines, supporting continuous quality validation.
  • Leverage AI-powered testing tools and automation frameworks to improve test design, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency while reducing maintenance effort.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to support manual testing activities, including test case generation, exploratory testing, requirement analysis, test data creation, and defect investigation to improve test effectiveness and productivity.

Job Title - Customer Acquisition and Experience Lead

Experience: 2–5 Years (relevant experience) 

Location: Bengaluru, India (On-Site)

Employment Type: Full-Time (6-days Work Week)

Compensation: ₹5–8 LPA (CTC)


About Stance Health

Stance Health is an evidence-backed physiotherapy and performance healthcare company focused on injury prevention, pain management, movement optimisation, rehabilitation and performance enhancement. Through technology-backed assessments, evidence-based treatment protocols and long-term strength programmes, we help individuals recover better, move better and perform at their highest potential.

We operate five centres across Bengaluru — HSR, Whitefield, Indiranagar, JP Nagar and Koramangala — delivering 5,000+ sessions every month. As we expand across Bengaluru, we are building the systems, processes and customer experience capabilities needed to scale Stance into a leading high-performance healthcare brand.


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Customer Acquisition & Experience Lead to work closely with the founding team and own the customer journey from the first enquiry through appointment booking, centre visits, follow-ups and continued engagement. The role combines centralised calling-team management and lead conversion with customer experience, centre operations and process improvement.

You will lead the day-to-day performance of the centralised calling function, strengthen lead allocation and follow-up discipline, improve conversion, and ensure customers receive a consistent, professional experience across Stance centres. You will use CRM and calling data, customer feedback and on-ground observations to identify root causes, implement solutions and track measurable outcomes. This role requires direct ownership and execution — not just reporting, complaint handling or coordination.



Key Responsibilities

1.Customer Acquisition and Centralised Calling Ops

  • Own day-to-day centralised calling operations across inbound enquiries, outbound lead calling, appointment bookings, customer follow-ups and service-related requests.
  • Manage calling-team performance, including lead allocation, agent productivity, daily and weekly targets, workload distribution, shift/roster coordination and adherence to defined processes.
  • Improve lead conversion through timely first contact, lead prioritisation, structured follow-up schedules, clear call outcomes and regular funnel reviews.
  • Track key acquisition metrics, including first response time, contact rate, missed-call rate, follow-up adherence, appointment booking rate, lead-to-appointment conversion and no-show recovery.
  • Build reliable recovery processes for missed calls, uncontacted leads, pending follow-ups, appointment cancellations, no-shows and lost or inactive leads.
  • Use a CRM to assign and track every enquiry, follow-up, lead status, funnel stage and conversion outcome. Use cloud telephony, where available, to monitor call activity, missed calls and call recordings.
  • Review call quality and customer conversations; coach team members on communication, objection handling, follow-up discipline and conversion effectiveness.
  • Work with marketing and centre teams to improve lead handovers, lead quality feedback, appointment attendance and the transition from enquiry to centre visit.


2. Customer Experience & Journey Management

  • Own and evaluate the end-to-end customer journey, from the initial enquiry and onboarding through appointment booking, centre visits, service delivery, follow-ups and continued engagement.
  • Identify friction points, service gaps and recurring complaints that affect trust, conversion, satisfaction or retention; drive corrective action with clear ownership and timelines.
  • Improve response times, appointment coordination, customer communication, follow-up quality and issue resolution across customer touchpoints.
  • Track Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) through suitable feedback mechanisms, monitor complaints and resolution time, and address recurring causes rather than repeatedly escalating the same issues.
  • Strengthen customer engagement, referral, reactivation and win-back initiatives in collaboration with relevant teams.


3.Centre Operations & Process excellence

  • Visit Stance centres regularly to observe how customer-facing processes are executed and identify gaps between defined SOPs and on-ground practice.
  • Monitor adherence to standards across front-desk processes, customer communication, appointment coordination, customer handovers and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Work with centre, clinical, customer support and operations teams to resolve issues affecting service quality and customer experience.
  • Track recurring operational issues and implement practical corrective measures; support the development and improvement of scalable processes as new centres are added.


4.Retention, Engagement & Business Operations

  • Analyse missed appointments, customer drop-offs, repeat visits, retention patterns and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with relevant teams on follow-up mechanisms, referral programmes, customer engagement and reactivation initiatives.
  • Evaluate initiatives using customer and business metrics, and make improvements based on observed outcomes.

5.Data, Team Performance & Cross Functional Execution

  • Review CRM reports, calling dashboards, customer feedback and operational data to identify bottlenecks, root causes and performance gaps.
  • Establish a practical daily/weekly review rhythm for calling performance, funnel movement, follow-up adherence, customer issues and agreed corrective actions.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in inside sales, telesales, contact-centre/call-centre operations, customer acquisition, customer experience or service operations.
  • Hands-on experience in supervising or leading an inside-sales or tele-calling team, including performance monitoring, coaching, productivity and team target achievement.
  • Demonstrated ownership of lead-conversion, sales or customer-acquisition targets, with measurable outcomes.
  • Practical experience managing inbound/outbound calling, lead pipelines, lead allocation, follow-up schedules, call dispositions and escalation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience using a CRM to track leads, follow-ups, funnel stages and conversion outcomes; familiarity with cloud telephony is preferred.
  • Understanding of acquisition and calling metrics such as first response time, contact rate, missed-call recovery, follow-up adherence, appointment conversion and agent productivity.
  • Ability to use customer feedback, CRM reports and operational data to identify problems and implement measurable improvements.
  • Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for operational tracking and reporting.
  • Comfort with regular on-ground work and travel across Bengaluru centres, managing multiple priorities and working independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Healthcare or physiotherapy experience is helpful but not mandatory.


Relevant Metrics & Systems Experience

  • Acquisition Metrics: Hands-on experience tracking first response time, contact rate, missed-call rate, follow-up adherence, appointment booking rate, lead-to-appointment conversion, and no-show recovery.
  • Customer Experience Metrics: Familiarity with tracking customer satisfaction (CSAT), complaint volume, resolution time, customer feedback, and recurring service issues.
  • Calling Team Performance: Experience monitoring agent productivity, reviewing call quality, tracking target achievement, and coaching team members to improve performance.
  • CRM & Calling Systems: Hands-on experience using CRM systems to manage lead ownership, follow-up history, funnel stages, and conversion reporting. Familiarity with cloud telephony tools for tracking call activity, missed calls, and recordings is an added advantage.


Who Will Succeed in this Role?

  • Demonstrates strong people-management skills and can lead, motivate, and develop a team while maintaining high standards of customer communication and follow-up discipline. 
  • Balances conversion targets with clear, professional and trustworthy customer communication.
  • Uses data and direct observation to diagnose problems, test improvements and check whether they are sustained.
  • Is comfortable coaching frontline team members, visiting centres and working through issues with multiple teams.
  • Can move between daily execution, root-cause problem-solving, performance reviews and process improvement.


What This Role is Not

This is not a conventional customer-support or complaint-handling role, nor is it a purely analytical, reporting or coordination position. The role requires active ownership of centralised calling performance and lead conversion, alongside improving customer experience and the consistency of customer-facing processes across centres.


﻿Why Join Stance Health?

  • Help shape the centralised calling function and customer journey in a growing, multi-centre healthcare business.
  • Take ownership of initiatives that influence conversion, customer satisfaction, retention and business performance.
  • Build scalable operating practices as Stance continues to expand across Bengaluru.


If you enjoy building disciplined acquisition processes, coaching teams and improving real customer experiences through hands-on execution, we would like to hear from you.

Job Summary

 

We are looking for a customer-focused Customer Support Executive to handle customer queries and provide timely assistance across chat, calls, and email channels. The candidate will be responsible for resolving customer concerns, providing accurate product and service information, following up on pending issues, and ensuring a smooth and satisfactory customer experience on the Aura Gold platform.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Customer Query Handling

 

  • Handle customer queries through live chat, phone calls, emails, and other communication channels.
  • Provide accurate information about Aura Gold products, digital gold transactions, purchases, sales, withdrawals, and delivery services.
  • Assist customers with account registration, KYC verification, payment processes, and app-related queries.
  • Ensure responses are clear, professional, personalised, and customer-friendly.
  • Maintain timely responses and follow up with customers to ensure their queries are addressed.

 

2. Transaction & Payment Support

 

  • Assist customers with payment-related concerns, including failed, pending, or successful transactions.
  • Handle queries related to money debited but gold not credited.
  • Support customers with Autopay registration, activation, cancellation, and transaction-related issues.
  • Follow up on pending refunds, sell transactions, and withdrawal payouts.
  • Coordinate with the relevant internal teams to resolve transaction discrepancies.

 

 

 

3. Gold Purchase, Sell & Delivery Support

 

  • Assist customers with queries related to gold purchase, selling, and withdrawal processes.
  • Provide updates on gold transaction status and applicable processes.
  • Handle customer queries regarding physical gold redemption and delivery status.
  • Follow up on delayed, missing, or incorrect gold deliveries.
  • Ensure customers receive proper guidance throughout the transaction and delivery process.

 

4. Customer Issue Resolution & Escalation

 

  • Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions within the defined timelines.
  • Handle dissatisfied customers professionally and maintain a calm, solution-oriented approach.
  • Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the Customer Support Lead.
  • Coordinate with Payments, Technology, Product, Vault, Delivery, and other relevant teams for issue resolution.
  • Immediately report suspicious transactions or suspected fraudulent activities to the concerned team.
  • Maintain proper records of customer complaints, escalations, and resolutions.

 

5. Customer Follow-ups & Engagement

 

  • Conduct regular follow-ups with customers regarding pending queries, transactions, and complaints.
  • Make outbound calls to customers wherever required for issue resolution and service updates.
  • Follow up with customers for Autopay activation and successful registration.
  • Reach out to customers for feedback and assistance based on business requirements.
  • Follow up on negative customer reviews and support efforts to improve customer satisfaction.

 

6. Customer Feedback & Quality

 

  • Maintain a high standard of customer service across all communication channels.
  • Follow approved SOPs, communication guidelines, and response templates.
  • Avoid repetitive or irrelevant copy-paste responses and ensure personalised communication.
  • Collect customer feedback and highlight recurring concerns to the Customer Support Lead.
  • Maintain professional communication and ensure customer information is handled confidentially.

 

7. Documentation & Reporting

 

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, follow-ups, and resolutions in the CRM or ticketing system.
  • Update ticket status and ensure no customer query remains unattended.
  • Prepare daily activity reports and share pending issues with the reporting manager.
  • Follow the defined shift schedule, attendance requirements, and support processes.

 

 

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

 

  • First Response Time (FRT)

  • Call & Chat Quality Audit Score
  • Autopay Follow-up and Activation

  • Pending Ticket and Escalation Management
  • Customer Feedback and Service Quality

 

Key Skills & Competencies

 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong customer-handling and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to understand customer concerns and provide effective solutions.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Patience and empathy while handling difficult or dissatisfied customers.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple customer queries simultaneously.
  • Good attention to detail and follow-up skills.

  • Familiarity with CRM, ticketing, and chat-support tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar is an added advantage.

Location: Bengaluru | Experience: 10–13 years | Role: Senior Technical Architect - Javascript &AI


About us

RockED is the premier people development platform for the automotive industry, supporting the entire employee lifecycle from pre-hire and onboarding to upskilling and career transitions. With microlearning content, gamified delivery, and real-time feedback, RockED is educating the automotive workforce and solving the industry's greatest business challenges. 

The RockED Company Inc. is headquartered in Florida. Backed by top industry experts and investors, we’re a well-funded startup on an exciting growth journey. Our R&D team (Indian entity) is at the core of all product and technology innovation

We partner with 10000+ dealerships, empower 60,000+ learners, complete 15000+ certifications, and have crossed 11 million lesson completions


Check out our website: https://www.rocked.us/ 


What will you own?


  • Own the architecture of RockED’s full stack: Node.js backend services, React web apps, React Native mobile apps, data layer and cloud infrastructure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, maintainable systems with clear service boundaries, API contracts and data models.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and document key decisions and trade-offs so the whole team understands the “why.”

Zero-to-one builds and system evolution

  • Build new systems and products from scratch, from first design to production rollout.
  • Lead major system redesigns and migrations, evolving the platform without disrupting users.
  • Pay down tech debt strategically, knowing when to refactor, when to rebuild and when to leave it alone.

Hands-on engineering

  • Write production code across the stack every week. This isn’t a “slides and diagrams” architect role.
  • Build core business logic, APIs and data pipelines, and design relational database schemas for integrity, security and fast retrieval.
  • Own features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring.

Performance and user experience at scale

  • Make our apps fast, from API response times and database query optimisation to mobile app performance and front-end rendering.
  • Build with the end user in mind: smooth, reliable and responsive experiences on every device.
  • Set up observability (logging, monitoring and tracing) so problems are caught before users notice them.

AI-native architecture

  • Define how AI fits into the platform, including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents and intelligent features that make learning more personal.
  • Prototype quickly, measure honestly, and take AI from hackathon idea to production-grade feature.
  • Lead AI-assisted development in engineering: AI coding tools, automated testing and code review.

Technical influence and standards

  • Build agreement on architecture decisions through clear thinking and strong communication, not authority.
  • Explain complex trade-offs simply to engineers, product managers and leadership alike.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, and raise the technical bar across the team.
  • Work closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well-built products and shape the technical roadmap.


Who Tends to Thrive Here?


Experience

  • 10–13 years in software engineering, with significant experience at high-growth, product-based startups.
  • Proven experience building systems from zero to one and leading major architecture and design changes.
  • Prior work on B2C applications where performance and user experience mattered.

Technical depth (must-have)

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in the JavaScript ecosystem: Node.js on the backend; React and React Native on the frontend.
  • Strong command of relational databases: schema design, query optimisation, indexing and data integrity.
  • Solid system design: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design (REST/GraphQL) and caching strategies.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), code quality and secure coding practices (OWASP).
  • Experience with Sequelize, MongoDB and AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3).
  • Experience with mobile-first products and app performance tuning.

AI expertise (must-have)

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and AI APIs.
  • A forward-looking view of where AI is heading, and how to architect for it.
  • Daily use of AI tools in your own engineering workflow.

Who you are

  • Geeky and curious: you read engineering blogs for fun, try every new tool, and are always learning.
  • A builder at heart: you’d rather ship than talk about shipping.
  • An influencer, not a manager: you lead through expertise and earn trust through good decisions.
  • A clear communicator: you make complex ideas simple and trade-offs obvious.
  • Experimental and resilient: you try bold ideas, learn quickly from what doesn’t work, and see things through to completion.


Why leaders choose RockED


  • Architect at the source: shape the technical foundation of a platform used across the US automotive industry.
  • An AI-first playground: leadership backing to experiment with and ship AI features, plus regular AI hackathons. [Add hackathon highlights and AI projects.]
  • A real seat at the table: work directly with RockED's founders and US leadership. Your voice shapes company strategy, not just engineering execution.
  • A proven business to scale: 10,000+ dealerships, 60,000+ learners and 11M+ lesson completions. You'll be scaling a business with established product-market fit.
  • Global leadership exposure: lead across US and India teams, and build your profile as a leader of global product engineering.
  • A team worth leading: engineers from IIT and ISB, and alumni of Adobe, Microsoft, Walmart and more, in a culture of high ownership and fast decision-making.
  • Room to grow with the company: as RockED scales, so does the scope of this role.
  • Care for you and your family: health and insurance coverage, fully sponsored by RockED.

Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.


Protegrity is seeking a passionate and talented Technical Lead to join our team.


We need people who recognize the opportunity, can plan effectively, take action and execute in the enterprise marketplace with our intuitive, diverse, and future-forward global teams. So, are you up for collaborating with the best in data security?

Join us on this journey and make an impact with one of the top 25 global software providers. We look forward to making our world become a better place with you on our team.

  • You are a dedicated and accomplished Technical Lead invited to join our team. In this role, you will assume responsibility for guiding the development of the Protegrity platform, ensuring strict adherence to architectural standards, and providing expert technical leadership across multiple teams. Success in this capacity requires exceptional collaboration with architects and senior engineers, as well as the ability to advocate for innovative design principles and foster a culture of technical excellence throughout our product teams.
  • This position is ideally suited for experienced professionals who excel at developing robust technological solutions and are motivated to oversee the complete end-to-end product delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Leverage advanced technical leadership capabilities and substantial industry experience to design, implement, and uphold best practices, offering trusted counsel to promote sustainable, long-term growth while cultivating highly credible relationships with all stakeholders.
  • Remain at the forefront of industry and technological best practices and trends, with specific expertise in microservices architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and other cloud technologies like AWS, GCP, Azure, to deliver value-added solutions.

  • Work with stakeholders in the company (E.g. Product Management, Architects, Engineers; but not limited to) to determine needs of new product features, releases and overall platform.

The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing using a combination of manual testing and automated tools to validate end to end system performance. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst supports external clients through their testing cycles by providing detailed release notes with every delivery, triaging issues reported, and engaging clients to review system discrepancies as needed. The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst will provide training t


Responsibilities:

  • Review requirement documentation to ensure understanding of the scope of the project and what needs to be tested.
  • Create and maintain test plans and test cases designed to offer adequate test coverage and minimize escaped defects.
  • Create and maintain Quality Assurance matrices of test coverage, slippage ratios, and other pertinent quality metrics.

  • Complete full regression testing and analyze test results.
  • Manage code and data migrations across multiple testing and production environments.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools to support manual testing activities, including test case generation, exploratory testing, requirement analysis, test data creation, and defect investigation to improve test effectiveness and productivity.
