Title - AI Architect

Experience: 8–12 years

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid)


Role Summary:

We P99Soft are looking for a senior AI Architect to own system-level design and architecture decisions across a portfolio of production AI initiatives. This role goes beyond assembling common frameworks - it requires the judgment to evaluate deep architectural trade-offs (model quality vs. size vs. cost, deterministic vs. generative approaches, and verification/testing strategy) and translate them into coherent, maintainable system architecture at scale.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define end-to-end system architecture and technical direction for AI-driven platforms, spanning retrieval-augmented generation, agentic/tool-using systems, vision and language model applications, and semantic search.
  • Evaluate and own core architectural trade-offs: model quality vs. size vs. cost, deterministic vs. generative system design, latency and scalability, and the design of output-verification and evaluation harnesses.
  • Provide technical leadership and design review across multiple concurrent initiatives, guiding implementation teams on build-out.
  • Track and apply emerging AI/ML research and techniques where they meaningfully improve system design and reliability.
  • Define the boundary between deterministic, verifiable system components and generative/agentic components based on the problem being solved.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex system-level issues — reliability, performance, or output-quality problems beyond routine debugging.


Required Experience & Skills:

  • 8–12 years of overall engineering experience, including substantial hands-on depth in applied or foundational AI/ML system design - this is a non-negotiable baseline, not familiarity with AI tools as an end user.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting AI/ML systems at production scale, beyond simple retrieval or prompt-based implementations.
  • Strong grasp of trade-offs across model quality, size, cost, latency, and determinism, and how these decisions shape system architecture.
  • Working knowledge of current and emerging generative AI / LLM techniques and research directions, and the ability to evaluate when they are appropriate to apply.
  • Experience architecting one or more of: retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, agentic/tool-using systems, vision models, semantic search, or automated verification and evaluation systems.
  • Comfort operating across multiple concurrent initiatives and translating research-adjacent concepts into buildable, production-grade systems.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in domains with strong internal-tooling or quality/verification requirements.
  • Exposure to developer-facing tooling or code-analysis systems.

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with EDK II / EDK2 / TianoCore or equivalent UEFI development environments.
  • Good understanding of x86 server architecture (Intel and/or AMD).
  • Experience in boot flow debugging and platform initialization.
  • Knowledge of ACPI, SMBIOS, PCIe, CPU, and memory initialization.
  • Understanding of Secure Boot, TPM, and firmware security concepts.
  • Experience with firmware builds, integration, debugging, and validation.

  • We are looking for a Senior Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) Functional QA Engineer to join the existing Global Trade Management team and drive high-quality functional testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud GTM applications and integrations.

  • The successful candidate will ensure the quality and reliability of GTM solutions through comprehensive functional testing, regression validation, and end-to-end business process verification.

Candidate Profile

  • A highly skilled Oracle Functional QA professional with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Trade Management.
  • Experienced in large-scale Oracle Cloud environments and enterprise testing frameworks.
  • A proactive contributor who can quickly understand business requirements and validate GTM solutions against expected outcomes.
  • Strong functional understanding of global trade compliance, customs, product classification, restricted party screening, licenses, permits, and trade agreements.
  • Comfortable validating end-to-end processes across Oracle GTM, ERP, SCM, OIC, transportation, and external trade-content or government-facing applications.

Candidate Profile

  • A proactive contributor who can quickly understand business requirements and validate planning solutions against expected outcomes.

Job Title : AWS Data Engineer / Data Lake Engineer

Experience : 2 to 4 Years

Location : Gurugram Sector 43

Work Mode : 5 Days WFO

Employment Type : Full-Time


About the Role :

We are looking for a skilled AWS Data Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms.

The candidate will work on an enterprise AWS Data Lake platform that collects data from multiple business systems, processes large datasets, and makes them available for analytics, reporting, and application development.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS data services, Python, PySpark, SQL, and Apache Airflow, along with an understanding of data warehousing and API-based data serving.


Mandatory skills :

AWS Data Lake, S3, EMR, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, RDS, DMS, IAM, Python, PySpark, Apache Airflow, Advanced SQL, ETL / ELT Pipelines, Data Modeling, PostgreSQL, Production Support.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data ingestion and ETL / ELT pipelines on AWS.
  • Work with AWS services such as S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, RDS, and DMS.
  • Build and manage data processing workflows using Python, PySpark, and Apache Airflow.
  • Implement data lake architecture with staging, curated, and consumption layers.
  • Write complex SQL queries and perform data transformation, validation, and modeling.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and RDS for structured data storage and consumption.
  • Support API-based data access using Hasura GraphQL or similar technologies.
  • Monitor production data pipelines, troubleshoot failures, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Optimize Spark jobs, SQL queries, and data pipelines for performance and cost efficiency.
  • Follow AWS security practices, IAM permissions, and data governance standards.
  • Collaborate with application, analytics, and business teams to understand data requirements.


Mandatory Skills :

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in Data Engineering, AWS Data Engineering, or Data Platform Development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services : S3, Glue, EMR, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, RDS, DMS, and IAM.
  • Good experience in Python and PySpark.
  • Practical experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of database concepts.
  • Experience in building and supporting ETL / ELT pipelines.
  • Understanding of Data Lake architecture, data warehousing, and data modeling.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
  • Experience handling production pipeline issues and troubleshooting.


Good to Have :

  • Experience with Hasura GraphQL or any GraphQL-based API / data-serving platform.
  • Knowledge of DBT (Data Build Tool).
  • Understanding of Lakehouse architecture and table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake.
  • Experience with Kafka or other streaming data technologies.
  • Knowledge of Amazon Redshift performance optimization, distribution keys, and sort keys.
  • Experience with AWS Aurora and API Gateway.
  • BFSI, Banking, or Insurance domain experience.


Ideal Candidate Profile :

  • Strong hands-on technical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working on real-time or batch-based production data pipelines.
  • Good understanding of data processing, transformation, and storage concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work independently.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.


Note : Candidates with strong practical experience in AWS Data Lake, PySpark, Airflow, Python, and SQL will be preferred. Real-world project experience is more important than theoretical knowledge or certifications.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
TECHJAYS


Senior Account Manager

Position: Senior Account Manager

Experience: 10+ Years

Industry: IT Services / Software Development / Technology Consulting

Location: Coimbatore / Hybrid

Joining: Immediate / Within 30 Days


Primary Skills: Enterprise Account Management, Strategic Client Relationships, Revenue Growth, Account Expansion, Consultative Selling, Commercial Negotiations, Account Profitability, Stakeholder Management.

Preferred Skills: AI/ML Services, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Software, HubSpot CRM, International Account Management, Agile Delivery.


About Techjays


At Techjays, we're helping businesses reimagine how they build, operate, and scale with AI at the core. We partner with organizations worldwide to design and deliver AI-powered software solutions that solve complex business challenges and create measurable business value.

Our global team brings together experienced technology professionals from organizations such as Google, Akamai, NetApp, ADP, Cognizant Consulting, and Capgemini.

We work with clients ranging from innovative startups to large enterprises, delivering custom AI solutions, software engineering services, and digital transformation initiatives.

We're looking for a Senior Account Manager who can take ownership of strategic client relationships, drive account growth, and build long-term partnerships with enterprise customers.

This role goes beyond traditional account management. You will be responsible for understanding client business objectives, identifying new opportunities, growing existing engagements, managing commercial relationships, and ensuring long-term account success.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial ownership, and the ability to engage confidently with senior executive stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Account & Client Relationship Management

  • Own and manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for client leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with CXOs, VPs, Directors, and other key decision-makers.
  • Understand client business objectives, technology roadmaps, operational challenges, and long-term priorities.
  • Develop strategic account plans covering revenue targets, stakeholder mapping, growth opportunities, risks, and client retention.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, identifying opportunities where technology and AI solutions can create business value.
  • Maintain strong client engagement throughout discovery, solutioning, project execution, and account expansion.

2. Revenue Growth & Business Development

  • Own annual account revenue targets and drive consistent growth across assigned accounts.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, new projects, additional engineering teams, and new service offerings.
  • Develop account expansion strategies based on client requirements and emerging business opportunities.
  • Lead consultative discovery discussions to understand business challenges and identify potential technology solutions.
  • Build business cases, ROI models, and commercial proposals to support client investment decisions.
  • Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Drive renewals, contract extensions, and long-term engagement opportunities.

3. Commercial Ownership & Negotiations

  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations involving pricing, contracts, and engagement models.
  • Manage Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), rate cards, renewals, and change requests.
  • Monitor account revenue, gross margins, delivery costs, and overall profitability.
  • Identify commercial risks and take proactive measures to protect account margins.
  • Work closely with finance, pre-sales, and delivery teams to ensure commercial commitments are realistic and sustainable.
  • Balance client expectations with business objectives and organizational profitability.

4. Delivery Governance & Client Success

  • Partner with engineering and delivery leaders to ensure projects meet agreed scope, quality, timelines, and commercial expectations.
  • Participate in project planning, scoping discussions, and SOW preparation.
  • Establish account governance through regular client reviews, monthly business reviews, steering committee meetings, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Monitor client satisfaction, account health, delivery performance, and potential relationship risks.
  • Manage senior-level escalations and lead recovery plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Ensure effective communication between clients and internal delivery teams.
  • Stay involved beyond contract closure to ensure successful execution and long-term client retention.

5. Consultative Selling & Solutioning

  • Work closely with pre-sales and technical teams to understand client requirements and develop relevant technology solutions.
  • Lead client discovery sessions and translate business challenges into solution opportunities.
  • Drive proposals, solution presentations, and commercial discussions.
  • Position Techjays' AI, software engineering, automation, and digital transformation capabilities based on client business needs.
  • Communicate the business value, expected outcomes, and ROI of proposed solutions.
  • Ensure that client expectations and commercial commitments are aligned with actual delivery capabilities.

6. Leadership & Account Management Excellence

  • Mentor and guide junior account managers and support the development of account management capabilities.
  • Establish structured account management processes, playbooks, reporting standards, and account health metrics.
  • Improve pipeline visibility, revenue forecasting, and account performance reporting through CRM systems.
  • Share market intelligence, client feedback, and growth opportunities with senior leadership.
  • Contribute to service offering development and go-to-market strategies based on client insights.

Required Skills & Experience

Account Management & Enterprise Sales

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise account management, strategic client management, or consultative sales within the IT services or software industry.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Demonstrated experience in account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, renewals, and revenue generation.
  • Strong experience managing long-term, complex client engagements and multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience handling international clients and global enterprise accounts.

Business & Commercial Acumen

  • Strong understanding of account revenue, gross margins, profitability, pricing, and commercial planning.
  • Hands-on experience negotiating MSAs, SOWs, rate cards, contract renewals, and change requests.
  • Ability to develop account growth strategies, business cases, and ROI models.
  • Experience managing revenue forecasts, sales pipelines, and account financial performance.
  • Understanding of IT services engagement models, including Fixed Price, Time & Material (T&M), and Dedicated Teams.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Proven ability to engage with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, VPs, and senior technology leaders.
  • Strong consultative discovery and executive-level communication skills.
  • Ability to identify key decision-makers, understand stakeholder dynamics, and influence complex buying decisions.
  • Experience managing client escalations, resolving relationship challenges, and turning around at-risk accounts.

Technology & Delivery Understanding

  • Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), software engineering, and technology delivery models.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML, automation, enterprise software, and digital transformation services.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, pre-sales, product, and delivery teams.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies and distributed delivery environments.

Tools & Reporting

  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot.
  • Familiarity with pipeline management, revenue forecasting, account reporting, and account health metrics.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and business communication skills.

What We're Looking For Beyond Skills

  • Business Ownership: Takes responsibility for account revenue, profitability, retention, and long-term growth.
  • Strategic Thinking: Understands the bigger business picture and identifies opportunities beyond immediate client requirements.
  • Executive Presence: Can confidently engage with senior decision-makers and build trusted business relationships.
  • Commercial Mindset: Understands the balance between client satisfaction, delivery commitments, revenue, and profitability.
  • Consultative Approach: Asks the right questions, understands business challenges, and positions solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Accountability: Remains involved throughout the client lifecycle, from opportunity discovery to successful delivery and expansion.
  • Problem-Solving: Handles difficult client situations, escalations, and commercial challenges with a structured approach.
  • Leadership: Can guide internal teams, mentor junior account managers, and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling an account management function.
  • Experience developing account management processes, playbooks, and performance metrics from scratch.
  • Previous experience mentoring or leading a team of account managers.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML services, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience working with global clients and distributed engineering teams.
  • MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.


Join Techjays

If you're someone who can build lasting enterprise relationships, identify business opportunities, drive account revenue, and turn client partnerships into long-term business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.sanitizedComment:
Job Summary:

As a Software Development Engineer II in VoD Video Engineering team, you will design and build the core backend systems that power our Video-on-Demand platform — spanning content ingest, transcoding, adaptive bitrate packaging, and delivery at scale. You will own complex projects end-to-end, make meaningful architectural contributions, and play a hands-on role in raising the quality and reliability of our video processing infrastructure. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, media technology, and delivering exceptional streaming experiences to hundreds of millions of viewers.

About the Team:

VoD Video Engineering team is the backbone of our streaming platform — responsible for the entire lifecycle of on-demand video content, from ingest and transcoding through packaging, storage, and delivery. We own mission-critical systems that process thousands of hours of video daily, serving a global audience with reliability, low latency, and the highest quality of experience. Our team operates at the forefront of media technology, collaborating closely with CDN, playback, and content operations teams to continuously raise the bar on performance and scalability. If you're passionate about large-scale distributed systems and the technology behind modern video streaming, this is the team to be on.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend services for video ingest, transcoding job orchestration, ABR packaging, and content delivery workflows.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex VoD backend features — from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and operational handoff.
  • Write high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code; drive code review culture and champion engineering best practices within the team.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions for the VoD platform, evaluating trade-offs across throughput, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Integrate VoD pipeline components with internal platform services including CMS, CDN origin, DRM/entitlement systems, and metadata APIs.
  • Take ownership of production reliability: participate in on-call rotations, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive preventive improvements.
  • Optimize video processing workflows for cost efficiency, throughput, and time-to-publish — including transcoding profile tuning and pipeline parallelism.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, content operations, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions; help grow the overall capability of the team.

Skills and attributes for success:

  • 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience, with a strong track record building and operating distributed systems in production.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or Java with solid foundations in system design.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) — including compute, object storage (S3), managed queues (SQS/SNS), and serverless or containerized workloads.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems design: event-driven architectures, message queues (Kafka), workflow orchestration, and idempotency patterns.
  • Experience with storage systems, caching strategies (Redis, Memcached), and database query performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Comfort with observability tooling — logging, metrics, and tracing — and a habit of building production-ready services from day one.
  • Strong communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical approaches and trade-offs to peers, leads, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative team player who takes pride in lifting up those around them through mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Preferred education and experience:

• Bachelors/Master’s in computer science or a related field with 3+ years of experience in backend development

About TorqWars

TorqWars is building India's competitive RC racing. We are a sports-entertainment business running on three engines: experience-led arenas with timed racing, a league, and a D2C store for RC cars and parts. Our first arena opens soon in Bandra, Mumbai, and we are backed by The Foundery. Our mission is to make battling with machines a real sport. You will be part of the founding team that runs our first arena.


Role overview

You will run races and look after customers at our RC racing arena in Bandra. You will explain the rules and safety, manage races on the track, keep the cars and batteries ready, and make sure every customer has a great time.


Key responsibilities

  • Welcome customers, explain the rules and give safety briefings.
  • Start, monitor and reset races, and run the timing system.
  • Charge and check batteries and cars between sessions.
  • Help at the front desk and with in-store sales.
  • Keep the track and play area clean and safe.
  • Support tournaments, birthday parties and events.

KPIs

Races started on time, cars and batteries ready for every session, customer ratings and a clean safety record.


Requirements

  • Friendly and confident with people of all ages, including kids and groups.
  • Spoken Hindi and English. Marathi is a plus.
  • Available for shifts, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.
  • Punctual and reliable.

Good to have

Experience at a gaming zone, go-kart track, family entertainment centre, café or retail store. Interest in RC cars, gaming or motorsport.


How we assess

A quick AI voice interview with your camera on, about 15 minutes. It covers real moments on the floor: a child upset after losing a race, a group that arrives late for its slot and a car that stops mid-race. No experience or RC knowledge is needed; we train you. We hire for attitude: energy, reliability, honesty and care for customers. We may also call someone you worked for before we make an offer.


Your first 90 days

Trained on every car, the timing system and the safety rules, running races on your own, and trusted to host birthday parties, group bookings and tournaments.


What we offer

Full training on RC cars and race operations, and growth into a floor supervisor role.


Location

On-site at our Bandra arena, Mumbai (shift-based).


Hiring process

A short AI voice interview, a trial shift at the Bandra arena, and an offer within 1 week.


When you apply, share

  • Where you have worked with customers before.
  • Which shifts you can work.

About TorqWars

TorqWars is building India's competitive RC racing. We are a sports-entertainment business running on three engines: experience-led arenas with timed racing, a league, and a D2C store for RC cars and parts. Our first arena opens soon in Bandra, Mumbai, and we are backed by The Foundery. Our mission is to make battling with machines a real sport. You will work directly with the founders and own how your function is built from the ground up.


Role overview

You will work across the business with the founders, taking on the most important problem of the month and solving it end to end: opening the arena on time, fixing a supply issue, setting up a new sales channel, or building a process that does not exist yet. You will move between strategy and on-ground execution in the same day.


Key responsibilities

  • Own founder-priority projects end to end, from framing the problem to a shipped result.
  • Step in where the business is stuck: operations, supply chain and vendors, D2C, partnerships, finance or hiring.
  • Build the operating rhythm: trackers, dashboards, weekly reviews and decision notes.
  • Run quick analyses and models to support decisions: unit economics, pricing and scenarios.
  • Set up new processes and hand them over to a function owner once they work.
  • Represent the founders with vendors, partners and investors when needed.

KPIs

Projects shipped on time, problems closed rather than just analysed, and how quickly what you set up runs without you.


Requirements

  • Experience in a startup, consulting, investment or founder's office role, or as a founder. Senior candidates are welcome, and so are candidates with 3–5 years who have grown fast.
  • A track record of solving messy, cross-functional problems end to end.
  • Strong with numbers: spreadsheet models, unit economics and quick estimates.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, including one-page decision notes.
  • Comfortable switching between strategy and on-ground execution.

Good to have

Ex-founder. Consumer, retail, D2C, gaming or hardware experience. Uses AI tools to work faster.


How we assess

A quick AI voice interview with your camera on and your screen shared (about 20 minutes, five main questions): a messy problem you personally solved (the numbers, the decisions, who did what and what went wrong), a live TorqWars problem with real constraints to think through out loud, and what your last manager would say about you. We do not expect you to know RC cars; we will teach you the sport. We hire for intelligence, energy and integrity. Specific, honest and structured answers score well; generic or rehearsed answers do not. We look at what you have done in the last 2–3 years, and we speak to references before any offer.


Your first 90 days

Two founder-priority projects shipped end to end, a weekly operating review and company dashboard running, and at least one new process handed to an owner who runs it without you.


What we offer

Direct work with the founders across every function, exposure to building a company and a new sport from the early stage, and a path to lead a function. A two-year mission across the business, ending with a function of your own to lead.


Location

Work from office, Mumbai: our Worli office and the Bandra arena, plus vendor and partner sites when needed.


Hiring process

A short AI interview, a call with a founder, a 48-hour assignment on a real problem from our business for shortlisted candidates, a working session in Mumbai with reference checks, a final conversation with our co-founder, and an offer within 2 weeks of the first call.


When you apply, share

  • One messy problem you solved end to end: what was broken, what you did, and the result in numbers.
  • Current and expected CTC, and notice period.

# Job Description – Billing & Invoicing Specialist


**Job Title:** Billing & Invoicing Specialist

**Experience:** 4–6 Years

**Department:** Title Services / Billing Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time


### Job Overview


We are looking for a detail-oriented Billing & Invoicing Specialist with 4–6 years of hands-on experience in **customer billing, billing operations, invoice processing, accounts receivable, and billing research**.


The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of customer invoicing, order entry, reviewing purchase orders and contracts, investigating billing discrepancies, and resolving customer billing disputes. The candidate will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure accurate and timely customer billing.


### Key Responsibilities


* Create, review, and process customer invoices accurately and within defined timelines.

* Handle end-to-end customer billing and invoicing activities.

* Review contracts, purchase orders (POs), and supporting documents to ensure billing accuracy.

* Perform billing research and investigate invoice discrepancies.

* Research and resolve customer billing inquiries, disputes, and discrepancies.

* Handle order entry and verify order details before processing invoices.

* Manage accounts receivable (AR) activities and follow up on outstanding invoices when required.

* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and internal departments to resolve customer billing issues.

* Ensure adherence to company billing policies, procedures, and internal controls.

* Support month-end closing activities and other accounts receivable functions as required.

* Maintain accurate customer billing records and documentation.


### Required Skills & Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in **customer billing, billing operations, invoicing, or accounts receivable**.

* Hands-on experience in customer invoice creation, processing, and billing activities.

* Strong understanding of customer billing processes and order entry.

* Experience reviewing contracts, purchase orders, and supporting billing documents.

* Ability to investigate billing disputes and resolve customer discrepancies.

* Good analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Good verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic accounting tools.


### Preferred Experience


Candidates with practical experience in the following areas will be preferred:


* Customer Billing and Invoicing Operations

* Customer Invoice Processing

* Accounts Receivable (AR)

* Order Entry and Order Management

* Billing Research and Investigation

* Customer Billing Dispute Resolution

* Purchase Order (PO) and Contract Verification

* Customer Account Reconciliation


### Ideal Candidate Profile


We are specifically looking for candidates whose primary work experience has been in **Customer Billing and Invoicing Operations**, rather than general finance or accounting.


Candidates with hands-on experience in customer billing, processing customer invoices, researching billing discrepancies, handling order entries, managing accounts receivable, and resolving customer billing disputes will be given preference.


### Keywords for Candidate Sourcing


Customer Billing Specialist, Billing Specialist, Billing Executive, Invoicing Specialist, Accounts Receivable Executive, Billing Analyst, Order Management Specialist, Customer Billing Analyst, AR Analyst.
